raw_graphql_pull_request.body: ## Motivation Qwen3.8 context-parallel prefill now reads selected K/V tokens directly from the cache instead of gathering and concatenating each request’s full cached prefix. A small index-to-slot mapping pass eliminates redundant prefix copies and synchronization, reducing memory traffic and attention latency. ## Modifications ## Accuracy Tests ## Speed Tests and Profiling There are the nsys profile results when we apply for this PR. We can eliminate the redundant D2D copy. ## Checklist - [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit). - [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). - [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). - [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). - [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance). ## Review and Merge Process 1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process). 2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers. 3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so. - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci` 4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR. --- ### CI States Latest PR Test (Base): :no_entry_sign: [Run #40449790448](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40449790448) Latest PR Test (Extra): :x: [Run #40449790311](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40449790311) Latest PR Test (AMD ROCm 10): :hourglass_flowing_sand: [Run #40449790366](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40449790366)
